description: Homepage (gethomepage.dev) integration. Adds the service discovery annotations to the Ingress.

enabled.description: Add the Homepage annotations to the Ingress.

name.description: Name of the entry on the homepage. Sets the `gethomepage.dev/name` annotation.

description.description: Description of the entry on the homepage. Sets the `gethomepage.dev/description` annotation.

group.description: Group of the entry on the homepage. Sets the `gethomepage.dev/group` annotation.

icon.description: Icon of the entry on the homepage. Sets the `gethomepage.dev/icon` annotation.

href.description: Link of the entry on the homepage. Sets the `gethomepage.dev/href` annotation.

weight.description: Sort weight of the entry within its group. Sets the `gethomepage.dev/weight` annotation.

podSelector.description: Selectors of the pods used for the status of the entry. Sets the `gethomepage.dev/pod-selector` annotation.

key.description: Name of the setting. Sets the `gethomepage.dev/widget.$key` annotation.

customkv.description: Custom widget settings as a list of `key` and `value`. Each item sets a `gethomepage.dev/widget.$key` annotation.

enabled.description: Add the widget annotations to the Ingress.

type.description: Type of the widget. Sets the `gethomepage.dev/widget.type` annotation.

version.description: Version of the widget. Sets the `gethomepage.dev/widget.version` annotation.

url.description: URL the widget talks to. Sets the `gethomepage.dev/widget.url` annotation.

custom.description: Custom widget settings as a map of `key: value`. Each entry sets a `gethomepage.dev/widget.$key` annotation.

additionalProperties.description: Value of the widget setting. Supports Helm `tpl`, empty values are skipped.

widget.description: Widget shown with the entry on the homepage.
